Tired of wrestling with heavy timeline editors just to ship a product promo video? 🎬🤖

Meet huashu-motion: An innovative agent-skill toolkit that empowers AI coding agents to generate, compose, and dynamically edit commercial-grade promotional motion graphics directly through a browser interface.

🔥 The Problem Solved:
Until now, text-based AI coding agents struggled to bridge the gap into rich media asset generation. Huashu-motion provides a specialized agent skill and runtime enabling assistants like Claude Code and others to write, render, and refine complete product promotional videos, motion graphics, and audio scores from a simple prompt—complete with visual debugging.

✨ Key Features:
• Point-to-Edit Visual Debugging: Press C, click any element in the local browser editor, and issue natural language change requests that precisely update the underlying source code and timestamps.
• Composer Mode & Audio Synthesis: Generates ABC notation music scores programmatically and uses local instrument samplers to sync sound effects and background music natively without paid APIs.
• Web-Native Rendering Engine: Bypasses heavy black-box video models by outputting standard HTML, CSS, GSAP, and Canvas code, driven by local Chrome instances for fast multi-threaded frame capture.
• Comprehensive Director Rules: Incorporates robust production logic derived from quantitative analysis of top industry product launch films for strong pacing, color consistency, and responsive layouts.

🛠️ Built for AI Engineers, Frontend Developers, and Indie Hackers looking to automate launch videos, explainer reels, and data visualizers straight from a codebase or CSV dataset. Save hours of manual timeline editing today!

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-motion

Stop struggling with AI image generators that can't spell words correctly or place objects where you actually want them. OpenMOSS-Image has officially dropped, bringing a massive 5-billion-parameter DiT foundation model to open-source visual AI with native layout control and accurate typography rendering.

Historically, open-source image models have fallen short when it comes to rendering clear text inside images and maintaining strict spatial arrangements. MOSS-Image solves this head-on, giving developers enterprise-grade control over programmatic image synthesis. 

Here is what you get under the hood:
- Precise spatial layout control to dictate the exact placement of text and visual elements on the canvas
- Advanced typography generation for clear, readable, and contextually accurate text inside images
- Long-prompt support accepting up to 4K tokens for incredibly detailed, complex scene descriptions
- Day-0 ecosystem integration with ComfyUI, SGLang, vLLM-Omni, and fine-tuning toolkits like KohakuMossTrainer
- Low-constraint local fine-tuning starting as low as 6GB VRAM

Whether you are building custom marketing automation tools, dynamic product packaging generators, or your own fine-tuned image generation APIs, MOSS-Image bridges the gap between open-source freedom and closed-source precision.

Check out the repo, pull the weights, and start building today:
https://github.com/OpenMOSS/MOSS-Image

🎮 Bring AAA Nintendo Switch titles like Zelda natively to Apple Silicon Macs, iPhones, and iPads—without traditional emulation! 🚀

Tired of heavy instruction emulation slowing down your favorite games on Apple hardware? 

The MacNativeGames repository (https://github.com/ly05010419/MacNativeGames) lets you compile and run native ARM64 ports of popular Nintendo Switch games directly on Apple Silicon by translating NVN graphics calls straight to Metal and wrapping system services into a local, standalone executable using your own game ROM and keys.

🔥 Key Features:
• Direct Execution: Native ARM64 game code paired with a high-performance Metal graphics backend instead of slow legacy emulation.
• Zero-Stutter Shaders: Includes a crowd-sourced shader list with tens of thousands of variants to eliminate pipeline compilation stutter.
• Cross-Platform: Full support for macOS, iPhone, and iPad complete with integrated touch control layouts and high frame-rate rendering fixes.
• Automated Builds: Local build scripts that generate custom self-contained app targets straight from your user-supplied game files.

💡 Why Graphics & App Developers Will Love It:
Study advanced graphics API translation strategies from proprietary console command buffers to Apple's Metal framework, analyze custom asset pipeline prewarming implementations, and master modern binary packaging practices for multi-platform Apple deployment. 

Check it out on GitHub today and start experimenting with low-overhead graphics translation:
👉 https://github.com/ly05010419/MacNativeGames

Tired of your smart TV acting like a billboard instead of a display? 📺✨

Free My TV transforms bloated, ad-driven smart TV interfaces into a lightweight, high-performance home screen built entirely with Claude Code.

The Problem:
Stock operating system launchers on Google TV, LG webOS, and Samsung Tizen are bogged down by intrusive sponsored banners and autoplaying promotions. They waste system resources, eat up memory, and ruin the viewing experience. 

The Solution:
Free My TV replaces that heavy stock UI with a minimalist, customizable, open-source home screen designed for speed, efficiency, and zero distractions. 

Notable Features:
🚀 Cross-Platform Support: Works seamlessly across Google TV, Android TV, LG webOS, and Samsung Tizen via native developer mode integrations.
⚡ High Performance: Engineered with a rock-solid 60 FPS UI rendering profile that cuts memory consumption by a massive 60% compared to stock launchers.
🌤️ Smart Widgets: Features dynamic sun-following day and night themes, live weather forecasting, real-time crypto price tickers, and content recommendation feeds powered by the TMDB API.
🛡️ Built-in Safety: Includes automatic safety checks for protected system apps and an instant fallback mechanism to revert to the stock home screen after three crashes. Plus, a reliable one-button undo mechanism.

Why Developers Will Love It:
This repo is a masterclass in modern AI-assisted engineering. Study how Claude Code was used to rapidly scaffold, build, and deploy multi-platform consumer applications across heavily fragmented hardware ecosystems. Dive into clean build scripts, device-specific deployment pipelines, and low-overhead rendering techniques.

Whether you are building custom digital signage launchers for commercial Android TV hardware or experimenting with local automation scripts for embedded devices, this project is packed with value.

Check out the code and start customizing your setup today:
https://github.com/simbasjungles/free-my-tv

Tencent-Hunyuan just dropped Hy-Memory: A production-grade cognitive memory engine for LLM agents! 🚀

Building stateful LLM agents that actually remember things across sessions is notoriously difficult. Between context window limits, memory bloat, and fragmented data across different developer tools, building custom persistence layers is a massive engineering bottleneck. 

Hy-Memory completely transforms how AI agents handle long-term context by introducing a dual-system cognitive architecture with specialized pipelines for chat, working environments, and coding.

🔥 Key Features:
• Dual-System Cognitive Architecture: Features an 8-layer hierarchy for chat, multi-layer abstraction for work, and conflict reconciliation.
• Specialized Task Pipelines: Tailored processing paths including version-evolution diff-chain tracking for coding agents.
• MemHub Integration: A local-first desktop and CLI product that unifies conversation history and coding traces from tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Qwen Code into a single managed directory.
• Attributed RL Models: Open-source models like Hy-Memory-30B-A3B (alongside FP8 and GGUF versions) trained specifically for high-precision memory extraction.
• Flexible SDK: Modular Python SDK with zero-cost search routing and native support for vector and graph stores like ChromaDB, Qdrant, FAISS, and Neo4j.

Stop letting your agents suffer from short-term memory loss. Embed sophisticated long-term memory, factual consistency, and code-evolution tracking into your apps today.

👉 Check it out on GitHub: https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy-Memory
